day_atlas.usage: Three equal portrait panels rendered natively: news / AI / saved. No runtime image download.
day_atlas.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: native Android reader DAY THEME background atlas, not a UI mockup. Generate one wide image 1536x1024 divided into exactly three equal-width portrait scenes, flush adjacent panels, no gutters or borders. The app crops each third into a separate page background. All three scenes have a genuinely bright daylight palette: porcelain white, clear pale blue sky, faint warm sunlight, restrained ice-blue glass, no dark navy field, no green tint or white fog filter. Left third: elegant futuristic waterfront city in morning light, fine architectural silhouettes at the lower edges and quiet open sky. Middle third: airy clear glass neural orb and very fine connected light filaments near the upper-right and lower edges, quiet bright center, scientific and refined. Right third: sunlit crystalline archive, translucent glass arcs and facets at the outer edges over open pearl-blue sky. Each scene should be mostly calm negative space for reading, restrained detail at the periphery and lower third, subtle dimensional depth, sophisticated technology aesthetic. No text, numbers, lettering, logos, people, watermarks or rendered buttons. This is three pieces of wallpaper in one atlas. Keep any local generated output only within F:/SELF/Try/News/.cache/generated-backgrounds.
